sources.CdxA: SegmentTable.csv group 5 CdxA_Default 8.7 m2 (VECTO default when no certified air drag)
sources.payloads: SegmentTable.csv group 5: Long haul 2600/19300 kg, Regional delivery 2600/12900 kg (low/representative)
sources.assumed: tractor curb 8.5 t (BEV, assumed), Crr 0.006 (assumed, tyre-label class B/C), r 0.52 m (385/65 R22.5, as in T03), wheels/axles inertia +3 %

gaps.note: pole change 0.17 s (H11s R01); AMT shift 0.5 s assumed (lit-scout to source); mode/gear switches only if the other one is >2 % (and >0.3 kW) better for >= 3 s, or if the current one cannot deliver the force
